Rahab, Joshua 2. A woman in a city marked for judgment told two spies she knew the Lord was God, and to hide a cord in the window, a sign, and the Lord would save her and her family. She put faith in the God of Israel, and He kept every thread of the promise. No past has to be the end of mercy; one honest, trembling, yes, to God can change a whole house. Trust the rescue He provides in Christ.
